    3D office

    office.agents.report write

    PUT /api/v1/office/agents MCP office_agents_report

    Report your live coding agents

    A reporter on your machine (flow office bridge, or any integration) sends every coding agent running there, every few seconds. Agents belong to you (the key's owner) and show at your desk in the 3D office of every environment you are a member of, or, working on an AgentFlow agent's card (agentflow, or a title such as "[Flow] Builder: #12 …"), at that agent's desk in the common area. Each source replaces only its own set, and a source that has not reported for 90 seconds is gone. Others see an agent's details only when its repo belongs to a project they can see (projects.update repos); otherwise just its mascot and status, as "Private project". Up to 200 agents and 20 children each are kept, and long strings are cut. The answer holds the Allow / Deny answers given in the office that this source has not been sent yet (also served by office.actions.wait).

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    sourcestringrequiredThe reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents.
    atstringWhen the reporter read its agents (ISO time).
    agentsany[]required
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 60,
      "description": "The reporter, e.g. \"bridge:laptop\". Each source replaces only its own agents."
    },
    "at": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 40,
      "description": "When the reporter read its agents (ISO time)."
    },
    "agents": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "description": "Stable and unique within the source, e.g. \"laptop:t3:thread-abc\"."
          },
          "title": {
            "description": "What it is working on (up to 200 characters)."
          },
          "vendor": {
            "description": "Which mascot it gets: claude, codex, gemini or other."
          },
          "model": {
            "description": "Display name, e.g. \"Opus 5.5\"."
          },
          "status": {
            "description": "running (working), waiting (on its person: a permission prompt or a question) or idle."
          },
          "activity": {
            "description": "What it is doing right now, e.g. \"Running tests\"."
          },
          "host": {
            "description": "The machine, e.g. \"laptop\"."
          },
          "hostLabel": {
            "description": "How to show where it runs, e.g. \"laptop · T3\"."
          },
          "repo": {
            "properties": {
              "name": {},
              "remote": {
                "description": "The git remote; credentials are dropped."
              }
            },
            "description": "The repository it works in: matched against projects' repos to decide who may see the details."
          },
          "children": {
            "description": "Its subagents (up to 20 kept).",
            "items": {
              "properties": {
                "id": {},
                "title": {},
                "vendor": {
                  "description": "Which mascot it gets: claude, codex, gemini or other."
                },
                "model": {},
                "status": {
                  "description": "running (working), waiting (on its person: a permission prompt or a question) or idle."
                }
              }
            }
          },
          "pending": {
            "description": "What it waits on (only kept while status is waiting).",
            "properties": {
              "requestId": {},
              "kind": {
                "description": "approval or question."
              },
              "summary": {
                "description": "e.g. \"Run: npm test\" (up to 500 characters)."
              },
              "can": {
                "items": {},
                "description": "allow and/or deny: the answers the reporter can carry out; [] when it can only be answered where it runs."
              }
            }
          },
          "agentflow": {
            "description": "The AgentFlow agent and card it works on, when the reporter knows: it then sits at that agent's desk in the office's common area. Resolved in each environment against its own agents and cards (elsewhere it keeps its own desk). Without it, Flow reads the title: \"[Flow] <Agent>: #<n> …\" (the agent runner's threads), or \"#<n>\" for a card delegated to exactly one agent.",
            "properties": {
              "agent": {
                "description": "The AgentFlow agent's id or name."
              },
              "card": {
                "description": "The card's number (12 or \"#12\") or id."
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "source",
    "agents"
  ]
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    actionsobject[]required
    actions[].idstringrequired
    actions[].agentIdstringrequired
    actions[].sourcestring
    actions[].requestIdstringrequired
    actions[].decisionenumrequiredOne of allow, deny.
    actions[].atstringrequired
    actions[].resultobject
    acceptedintegerHow many agents were kept.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "agentId": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "source": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "requestId": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "decision": {
            "enum": [
              "allow",
              "deny"
            ]
          },
          "at": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "result": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "ok": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "message": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "at": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "ok",
              "message",
              "at"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "agentId",
          "requestId",
          "decision",
          "at"
        ]
      }
    },
    "accepted": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "How many agents were kept."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "actions"
  ]
}

    Example: One agent waiting on a prompt

    curl -sS -X PUT "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/agents" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"bridge:laptop","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z","agents":[{"id":"laptop:t3:thread-abc","title":"Fix login bug","vendor":"claude","model":"Opus 5.5","status":"waiting","activity":"Waiting for approval","host":"laptop","hostLabel":"laptop · T3","repo":{"name":"flow","remote":"https://github.com/acme/flow.git"},"children":[],"pending":{"requestId":"req-1","kind":"approval","summary":"Run: npm test","can":["allow","deny"]},"agentflow":{"agent":"Builder","card":12}}]}'
    {
  "actions": [],
  "accepted": 1
}

      "repo": {
        "name": "flow",
        "remote": "https://github.com/acme/flow.git"
      },
      "children": [],
      "pending": {
        "requestId": "req-1",
        "kind": "approval",
        "summary": "Run: npm test",
        "can": [
          "allow",
          "deny"
        ]
      },
      "agentflow": {
        "agent": "Builder",
        "card": 12
      },
      "source": "bridge:laptop"
    }
  ],
  "sources": [
    {
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "agents": 1
    }
  ]
}

    office.actions.wait write

    GET /api/v1/office/actions MCP office_actions_wait

    Wait for answers to your agents' prompts

    Long-poll for the Allow / Deny answers given in the 3D office to this source's agents: returns as soon as one is queued, or an empty list after wait seconds (0 to 30; 0 answers at once). Each answer is delivered once (here or in the office.agents.report answer). Carry it out, then send the result with office.actions.result.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    sourcestringrequiredThe reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents.
    waitintegerSeconds to wait for an answer (0-30).
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "source": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 60,
      "description": "The reporter, e.g. \"bridge:laptop\". Each source replaces only its own agents."
    },
    "wait": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 0,
      "maximum": 30,
      "default": 0,
      "description": "Seconds to wait for an answer (0-30)."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "source"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    actionsobject[]required
    actions[].idstringrequired
    actions[].agentIdstringrequired
    actions[].sourcestring
    actions[].requestIdstringrequired
    actions[].decisionenumrequiredOne of allow, deny.
    actions[].atstringrequired
    actions[].resultobject
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "actions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "agentId": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "source": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "requestId": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "decision": {
            "enum": [
              "allow",
              "deny"
            ]
          },
          "at": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "result": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "ok": {
                "type": "boolean"
              },
              "message": {
                "type": "string"
              },
              "at": {
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "ok",
              "message",
              "at"
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "agentId",
          "requestId",
          "decision",
          "at"
        ]
      }
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "actions"
  ]
}

    Example: An answer

    curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions?source=bridge%3Alaptop&wait=25" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "act_1",
      "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "requestId": "req-1",
      "decision": "allow",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}

    office.actions.result write

    POST /api/v1/office/actions/{id} MCP office_actions_result

    Say how an answer went

    The reporter carried out (or could not carry out) an answer from office.actions.wait: the person who answered sees the message in the office right away.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    idstringrequiredThe action id (act_…).
    okbooleanrequired
    messagestringe.g. "Approved in T3".
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "The action id (act_…)."
    },
    "ok": {
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "message": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 300,
      "description": "e.g. \"Approved in T3\"."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "id",
    "ok"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    actionobjectrequired
    action.idstringrequired
    action.agentIdstringrequired
    action.sourcestring
    action.requestIdstringrequired
    action.decisionenumrequiredOne of allow, deny.
    action.atstringrequired
    action.resultobject
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "action": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "agentId": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "source": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "requestId": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "decision": {
          "enum": [
            "allow",
            "deny"
          ]
        },
        "at": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "result": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "ok": {
              "type": "boolean"
            },
            "message": {
              "type": "string"
            },
            "at": {
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "ok",
            "message",
            "at"
          ]
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "agentId",
        "requestId",
        "decision",
        "at"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "action"
  ]
}

    Example: Done

    curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions/act_1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"ok":true,"message":"Approved in T3"}'
    {
  "action": {
    "id": "act_1",
    "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
    "source": "bridge:laptop",
    "requestId": "req-1",
    "decision": "allow",
    "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "result": {
      "ok": true,
      "message": "Approved in T3",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }
}
